items.note: Unchanged this run - every ETA and ETD in the rotation matches the 14 Sep record exactly. The AA9 long-term schedule still lists only two voyages, WAN HAI 712 E002 (Port Klang 23 Aug, already in history and out of window) and WAN HAI 903 E002, which is why AA9 stays classified as an extra loader rather than a fixed string: n is 2, not weekly. For contrast the AA7 CSV pulled in the same burst is 2,532 bytes of continuous weekly sailings against 551 bytes for AA9, and AA8 and AA10 return empty 85-byte stubs, so there is no wider AAn programme behind it. The vsProforma comparator is a cross-carrier market benchmark (MSC EMPIRE SERVICE Ningbo to New York, 26 days, departing 19 Sep) rather than a Wan Hai proforma, because Wan Hai's own Ningbo to New York string on AA7 was not sampled on that exact pair this run. Read the +13 day delta as slower than the fastest thing on the water, not as a like-for-like carrier comparison.

items.note: Unchanged and now verified from two independent Maersk surfaces. The vessel-schedule page confirms the Asia legs and the canal call (Gwangyang 19 Sep, Yantian 23 Sep, Busan 28 Sep, Panama Canal 21 Oct) but publishes nothing past the canal; the Houston call comes from the routing API, which returns estimatedTimeOfArrival 2026-10-31T09:00 at USHOUTM (Barbours Cut). Both the Yantian and Busan lanes return exactly one XL sailing against six or seven TP15 sailings, so n is 1 on each. Delta is the same +8 days on both pairs: Yantian XL 38d against TP15 SAN FERNANDO 635E 30d, Busan XL 33d against the same TP15 sailing at 25d. WARNING FOR FUTURE RUNS: the routing API field isRoutingAdhoc is true on every routing returned for these lanes, including the plain proforma TP15 sailings. It is not an ad-hoc signal and must never be used as a trigger - the only thing separating this item from the rest of the lane is the serviceName XL sitting outside the registry.

Evergreen AUG surfaced on Yantian-Houston with 2 sailings in the 4-week Evergreen window (ONE ARCADIA 079E ETD 2026-10-03, EVER LUCKY 085E ETD 2026-10-05) alongside GME 3. n<=2 would normally make it an XL candidate, but the workup kills that: TVS2_ServiceMap line AUG returns "Asia-U.S. GULF Service(AUG)" with a fixed weekday proforma (Cai Mep, Yantian, Ningbo, Shanghai, Pusan, Panama Canal, Houston, Mobile, Panama Canal, PSA Panama, Kaohsiung, Cai Mep) and published ETA/ETD weekdays. That is a regular service, not an ad-hoc call. Promoted to serviceRegistry under Ocean Alliance this run rather than waiting for a second confirmation, because the fixed-weekday proforma is stronger evidence than a sailing count. Revert if a later run shows no weekday proforma.
